datasets.title: IOM Bangladesh - Needs and Population Monitoring (NPM) Drone imagery and GIS package by camp (August 2018)
datasets.description: NPM Bangladesh has produced a number of tools based on its regular data collection activities and drone flights. The package of August 2018 is based on NPM Site Assessment 12 (as of 4 September) and NPM most updated drone imagery (as of 11 September). Here below, the complete package by camp: SW Map package KMZ file Drone image The full image and shapefiles are available at this link .. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/iom-bangladesh-needs-and-population-monitoring-npm-drone-imagery-and-gis-package-by-camp-august-2018]

lineage.description: IOM conducted regular drone flights and site assessments (NPM Round 12) across refugee camps in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh. Drone imagery and field observations were processed into GIS-compatible shapefiles and KML files organized by individual camp, providing spatial inventories of population distribution and camp infrastructure.

sources.name: International Organization for Migration (IOM)
sources.description: Direct observational data from drone flights and site assessments documenting refugee camp populations and infrastructure across Cox's Bazar camps as of September 2018.
